name: Why-Nimbus closing CTA
purpose: Turn the reader of the company 'why us' story into a demo request with one centred heading and button.
description: A bare centred block (72rem max, margin 4rem top / 6rem bottom) holding a serif H2 and, 1rem below, a single primary button. No background or card. Side padding 1.5rem <=767 and 1rem <=479, where the button stretches to full width.
